lec02bi-frame-u01.name: lec02bi-frame-u01
lec02bi-frame-u01.text: 後驗保留完整不確定性

lec02bi-u01-1-title.name: lec02bi-u01-1-title
lec02bi-u01-1-title.text: 完整分布比一個值誠實

lec02bi-u01-1-point-text.name: lec02bi-u01-1-point-text
lec02bi-u01-1-point-text.text:
ML / MAP：只取一個值
Point estimates pick one number.
[補充 / Added] 明天氣溫猜 25 度。

lec02bi-u01-1-dist-text.name: lec02bi-u01-1-dist-text
lec02bi-u01-1-dist-text.text:
Bayesian inference：保留全部可能參數
A posterior retains uncertainty.
[補充 / Added] 猜 24–26 度，中間最可能。

lec02bi-u01-1-limit.name: lec02bi-u01-1-limit
lec02bi-u01-1-limit.text:
比喻限制：天氣不確定性不等於參數不確定性。
Weather uncertainty is not parameter uncertainty.

lec02bi-u01-1-intro.name: lec02bi-u01-1-intro
lec02bi-u01-1-intro.text:
Week 2 self-study · Unknown parameters · §2.5
Newly written text; worked example values, not textbook figures.

lec02bi-u01-2-meaning.name: lec02bi-u01-2-meaning
lec02bi-u01-2-meaning.text:
X：訓練資料；θ：未知參數。每個參數依後驗加權。
X: training data; theta: unknown parameter; posterior-weighted averaging.

lec02bi-u01-3-title.text: 十五個加權項重現積分

Predictive $\mathcal N(1.9048,1.4762)$
細線先加權，粗線為總和。
Weighted components match the integral.

lec02bi-u01-3-peak.text:
圖說峰值 0.3283；兩曲線幾乎重合。
Caption peak: 0.3283; curves nearly coincide.

lec02bi-u01-4-title.name: lec02bi-u01-4-title
lec02bi-u01-4-title.text: 貝氏推論不是另一個點估計

lec02bi-u01-4-wrong-text.name: lec02bi-u01-4-wrong-text
lec02bi-u01-4-wrong-text.text:
✗ 只換方法算一個參數值。
Just another point-estimation method.

lec02bi-u01-4-right-text.name: lec02bi-u01-4-right-text
lec02bi-u01-4-right-text.text:
✓ 輸出完整後驗，保留不確定性。
Returns the whole posterior, not one number.

lec02bi-u01-4-numerical.name: lec02bi-u01-4-numerical
lec02bi-u01-4-numerical.text:
[補充 / Added] 積分通常無閉式解，需數值方法。
MCMC · Gibbs sampling · Metropolis-Hastings

lec02bi-frame-u02.text: 資料增加使高斯後驗變尖

lec02bi-u02-1-title.text: 高斯先驗更新後仍是高斯

lec02bi-u02-1-assumption.text:
已知 σ²，未知 μ；先驗為高斯。
Known variance, unknown mean; Gaussian prior.

lec02bi-u02-1-symbols.name: lec02bi-u02-1-symbols
lec02bi-u02-1-symbols.text:
N：樣本數；x̄N：樣本平均。
μ₀, σ₀²: prior mean and variance.
μN, σN²: posterior mean and variance.

Values computed from the lecture formulas.

lec02bi-u02-3-interpret.text:
均值從 0 往 2 移動；變異數約以 1/N 縮小。
Mean approaches 2; variance shrinks roughly as 1/N.

lec02bi-u02-4-title.name: lec02bi-u02-4-title
lec02bi-u02-4-title.text: 資料改變權重而非消除不確定性

lec02bi-u02-4-quote-text.name: lec02bi-u02-4-quote-text
lec02bi-u02-4-quote-text.text:
資料越多，後驗越尖。
不確定性不是消失，而是被資料壓縮。

lec02bi-u02-4-en.name: lec02bi-u02-4-en
lec02bi-u02-4-en.text:
More data makes the posterior sharper.
Uncertainty is not gone; it is squeezed by the data.

Sample noise + uncertainty about the center.

lec02bi-u04-1-title.text: 三種方法保留的資訊不同

lec02bi-u04-1-ml-text.name: lec02bi-u04-1-ml-text
lec02bi-u04-1-ml-text.text:
ML
最大概似
One number: $\bar x_N$
Uses the likelihood.

lec02bi-u04-1-map-text.name: lec02bi-u04-1-map-text
lec02bi-u04-1-map-text.text:
MAP
最大事後機率
Posterior peak: $\mu_N$
Uses the prior and data.

lec02bi-u04-1-bayes-text.name: lec02bi-u04-1-bayes-text
lec02bi-u04-1-bayes-text.text:
Bayesian inference
貝氏推論
The whole posterior
Most uncertainty; highest cost.

lec02bi-u04-3-title.name: lec02bi-u04-3-title
lec02bi-u04-3-title.text: 資料多時三條路走到同一處

lec02bi-u04-3-quote-text.name: lec02bi-u04-3-quote-text
lec02bi-u04-3-quote-text.text:
資料少時，三條路差很多；
資料多時，三條路走到同一個地方。

lec02bi-u04-3-en.name: lec02bi-u04-3-en
lec02bi-u04-3-en.text:
With little data the routes differ; with plenty of data they agree.
A sharp posterior and diluted prior make Bayes, MAP and ML converge.

lec02bi-u04-3-caution-text.name: lec02bi-u04-3-caution-text
lec02bi-u04-3-caution-text.text:
[補充 / Added] MAP=後驗均值只因本例是對稱高斯。
Other distributions need not have mean = mode.

lec02bi-frame-u05.name: lec02bi-frame-u05
lec02bi-frame-u05.text: 最大熵不偷偷加入額外假設

lec02bi-u05-1-title.name: lec02bi-u05-1-title
lec02bi-u05-1-title.text: 已知限制內選最不武斷的分布

lec02bi-u05-1-constraints-c0-t.name: lec02bi-u05-1-constraints-c0-t
lec02bi-u05-1-constraints-c0-t.text:
寫下已知限制
Known constraints

lec02bi-u05-1-constraints-c1-t.name: lec02bi-u05-1-constraints-c1-t
lec02bi-u05-1-constraints-c1-t.text:
找符合條件的密度
Feasible densities

lec02bi-u05-1-constraints-c2-t.name: lec02bi-u05-1-constraints-c2-t
lec02bi-u05-1-constraints-c2-t.text:
選熵最大的密度
Maximize entropy

lec02bi-u05-1-entropy.name: lec02bi-u05-1-entropy
lec02bi-u05-1-entropy.text:
$$
H=-\int p(\mathbf x)\ln p(\mathbf x)\,d\mathbf x
$$

lec02bi-u05-1-symbols.name: lec02bi-u05-1-symbols
lec02bi-u05-1-symbols.text:
H：平均不確定度；p：待選密度；ln：自然對數，單位 nats。
Entropy measures average uncertainty; natural logarithms use nats.

lec02bi-u05-1-analogy.name: lec02bi-u05-1-analogy
lec02bi-u05-1-analogy.text:
[補充 / Added] 只知住台灣，不該假設住台北。
Knowing Taiwan does not justify assuming Taipei.

lec02bi-u05-2-title.name: lec02bi-u05-2-title
lec02bi-u05-2-title.text: 同一定義域上均勻分布熵最大

lec02bi-u05-2-table-text.name: lec02bi-u05-2-table-text
lec02bi-u05-2-table-text.text:
Candidate       Peak        H (nats)
Uniform        0.5000       0.6932
Triangular     1.0000       0.5000
Bimodal        1.0000       0.4600
Bell           1.1447       0.3455

lec02bi-u05-2-theory.name: lec02bi-u05-2-theory
lec02bi-u05-2-theory.text:
四種密度都在 [0,2]，面積為 1。
理論 Hmax=ln 2=0.6931；0.6932 為數值積分。
Same support, same grid; tiny integration gap.

lec02bi-u05-3-title.name: lec02bi-u05-3-title
lec02bi-u05-3-title.text: 更有結構不代表更誠實

lec02bi-u05-3-fig-entropybar-2-60.name: fig-entropybar-2-60
lec02bi-u05-3-fig-entropybar-2-60.text: entropybar：使用講義解析式與同一組數值繪製 / Analytic lecture figure

image.alt: entropybar：使用講義解析式與同一組數值繪製 / Analytic lecture figure

lec02bi-u05-3-wrong-text.name: lec02bi-u05-3-wrong-text
lec02bi-u05-3-wrong-text.text:
✗ 密度有峰、有結構就比較好。
Peaks look richer, so they must be better.

lec02bi-u05-3-right-text.name: lec02bi-u05-3-right-text
lec02bi-u05-3-right-text.text:
✓ 峰值可能是偷偷加入的假設。
More unsupported structure means lower entropy.
Only compare candidates satisfying known facts.

lec02bi-frame-u06.name: lec02bi-frame-u06
lec02bi-frame-u06.text: 只知道有限範圍得到均勻分布

lec02bi-u06-1-title.name: lec02bi-u06-1-title
lec02bi-u06-1-title.text: 乘子把限制納入熵的目標

lec02bi-u06-1-lagrange-c0-t.name: lec02bi-u06-1-lagrange-c0-t
lec02bi-u06-1-lagrange-c0-t.text:
範圍與歸一化
Support + total mass

lec02bi-u06-1-lagrange-c1-t.name: lec02bi-u06-1-lagrange-c1-t
lec02bi-u06-1-lagrange-c1-t.text:
加入未知乘子 λ
Add multiplier

lec02bi-u06-1-lagrange-c2-t.name: lec02bi-u06-1-lagrange-c2-t
lec02bi-u06-1-lagrange-c2-t.text:
求解後用限制定 λ
Fix λ afterward

lec02bi-u06-1-en.name: lec02bi-u06-1-en
lec02bi-u06-1-en.text: Only the support is known. Multiply the constraint by λ and include it in the objective.

lec02bi-u06-2-title.name: lec02bi-u06-2-title
lec02bi-u06-2-title.text: 駐點與歸一化決定常數密度

lec02bi-u06-2-derivative-text.name: lec02bi-u06-2-derivative-text
lec02bi-u06-2-derivative-text.text:
① 對 p(x) 微分並令其為零。
Differentiate and set to zero.
$\ln p(x)=\lambda-1$

lec02bi-u06-2-constant-text.name: lec02bi-u06-2-constant-text
lec02bi-u06-2-constant-text.text:
② 解出常數。
The density is constant.
$\hat p(x)=\exp(\lambda-1)$

lec02bi-u06-2-normalize-text.name: lec02bi-u06-2-normalize-text
lec02bi-u06-2-normalize-text.text:
③ 用總機率為 1 定出常數。
Normalization fixes the constant.
$\exp(\lambda-1)=1/(x_2-x_1)$

lec02bi-u06-2-principle.name: lec02bi-u06-2-principle
lec02bi-u06-2-principle.text:
只有範圍資訊，
不偏好任何位置。

Support alone
justifies no favored
position.

lec02bi-u06-3-title.name: lec02bi-u06-3-title
lec02bi-u06-3-title.text: 區間內常數且區間外為零

lec02bi-u06-3-fig-uniform-2-60.name: fig-uniform-2-60
lec02bi-u06-3-fig-uniform-2-60.text: uniform：使用講義解析式與同一組數值繪製 / Analytic lecture figure

image.alt: uniform：使用講義解析式與同一組數值繪製 / Analytic lecture figure

lec02bi-u06-3-quote.name: lec02bi-u06-3-quote
lec02bi-u06-3-quote.text:
一無所知時，最誠實的答案是均勻分布。
When you know nothing, choose the uniform density.

lec02bi-frame-u07.name: lec02bi-frame-u07
lec02bi-frame-u07.text: 限制條件決定最大熵的答案

lec02bi-u07-1-title.name: lec02bi-u07-1-title
lec02bi-u07-1-title.text: 三組限制帶出三種分布

lec02bi-u07-1-answers-c2-t.name: lec02bi-u07-1-answers-c2-t
lec02bi-u07-1-answers-c2-t.text:
實數軸＋均值與變異數
Gaussian

lec02bi-u07-1-principle.name: lec02bi-u07-1-principle
lec02bi-u07-1-principle.text:
同一套 Lagrange 方法；不是憑喜好挑分布。
The same multiplier recipe; constraints determine the answer.

lec02bi-u07-2-title.name: lec02bi-u07-2-title
lec02bi-u07-2-title.text: 有限區間內不偏好任何位置

lec02bi-u07-2-constraints-text.text:
Known support: [x₁,x₂]
Only the finite interval is known.
有限範圍限制 → 均勻分布

lec02bi-u07-2-numeric.name: lec02bi-u07-2-numeric
lec02bi-u07-2-numeric.text:
[0,2]：p=0.5；H=0.6931 nats.
Outside the interval the density is zero.

lec02bi-u07-3-title.name: lec02bi-u07-3-title
lec02bi-u07-3-title.text: 非負且已知均值得到指數分布

lec02bi-u07-3-fig-exp-2-60.name: fig-exp-2-60
lec02bi-u07-3-fig-exp-2-60.text: exp：使用講義解析式與同一組數值繪製 / Analytic lecture figure

image.alt: exp：使用講義解析式與同一組數值繪製 / Analytic lecture figure

lec02bi-u07-3-constraints-text.name: lec02bi-u07-3-constraints-text
lec02bi-u07-3-constraints-text.text:
非負定義域，且已知均值 μ。
Nonnegative support and known mean.
μ=1：p̂(x)=e⁻ˣ

lec02bi-u07-4-title.name: lec02bi-u07-4-title
lec02bi-u07-4-title.text: 實數軸均值與變異數給出高斯

lec02bi-u07-4-fig-normal-2-60.name: fig-normal-2-60
lec02bi-u07-4-fig-normal-2-60.text: normal：使用講義解析式與同一組數值繪製 / Analytic lecture figure

lec02bi-u07-4-constraints-text.name: lec02bi-u07-4-constraints-text
lec02bi-u07-4-constraints-text.text:
整條實數軸；已知 μ 與 σ²。
Real-line support; known mean and variance.
Example: μ=0, σ²=1

lec02bi-u07-4-clt.name: lec02bi-u07-4-clt
lec02bi-u07-4-clt.text:
高斯最不武斷；此理由與中央極限定理獨立但一致。
Independent of the central limit theorem, yet consistent with it.

lec02bi-u07-5-title.name: lec02bi-u07-5-title
lec02bi-u07-5-title.text: 不同定義域的熵不能直接排名

lec02bi-u07-5-wrong-text.name: lec02bi-u07-5-wrong-text
lec02bi-u07-5-wrong-text.text:
✗ 跨定義域直接比較 0.6931、1.0000、1.4189。
Ranking these entropies directly is not a fair comparison.

lec02bi-u07-5-right-text.name: lec02bi-u07-5-right-text
lec02bi-u07-5-right-text.text:
✓ 三個限制與定義域不同，不能直接比大小。
A fair entropy comparison needs one common support.

lec02bi-frame-u08.name: lec02bi-frame-u08
lec02bi-frame-u08.text: 練習連結後驗預測與最大熵

lec02bi-u08-1-title.name: lec02bi-u08-1-title
lec02bi-u08-1-title.text: 先代公式再比較預測變異數

lec02bi-u08-1-fig-prior-2-60.name: fig-prior-2-60
lec02bi-u08-1-fig-prior-2-60.text: prior：使用講義解析式與同一組數值繪製 / Analytic lecture figure

image.alt: prior：使用講義解析式與同一組數值繪製 / Analytic lecture figure

lec02bi-u08-1-question-text.name: lec02bi-u08-1-question-text
lec02bi-u08-1-question-text.text:
$\sigma^2=2$，prior $\mathcal N(0,10)$
$\bar x_N=3$，$N=4$
求 μN 與 σN²。
Find the posterior mean and variance.

lec02bi-u08-1-hint-text.name: lec02bi-u08-1-hint-text
lec02bi-u08-1-hint-text.text:
提示：直接代公式；再求預測變異數。
Hint: substitute into the formulas.
Find the predictive variance.
How much larger is it than σ²?

lec02bi-u08-1-noanswer.name: lec02bi-u08-1-noanswer
lec02bi-u08-1-noanswer.text:
只繪題目給定先驗，不附答案；於課堂或討論區討論。
Only the given prior is drawn. Discuss answers in class or on the board.

lec02bi-u08-2-title.name: lec02bi-u08-2-title
lec02bi-u08-2-title.text: 最大熵練習只使用已知限制

lec02bi-u08-2-calculation-text.name: lec02bi-u08-2-calculation-text
lec02bi-u08-2-calculation-text.text:
在 [0,3] 求最大熵分布與熵。
Find the maximum-entropy density and entropy on [0,3].
提示：總機率為 1。
Hint: total probability is one.

lec02bi-u08-2-explain-text.name: lec02bi-u08-2-explain-text
lec02bi-u08-2-explain-text.text:
為何只知道定義域時選均勻？
用一段話說明「不武斷」。
Why choose uniform with support alone?
Explain your reading of “least committal.”

lec02bi-u08-2-noanswer.name: lec02bi-u08-2-noanswer
lec02bi-u08-2-noanswer.text: No solutions included; discuss in class or on the discussion board.

lec02bi-u08-3-title.name: lec02bi-u08-3-title
lec02bi-u08-3-title.text: 求積節點數會影響近似結果

lec02bi-u08-3-question-text.name: lec02bi-u08-3-question-text
lec02bi-u08-3-question-text.text:
若第 1 節求積節點由 15 改為 4，
預測峰值會偏高還是偏低？為什麼？
If 15 quadrature nodes become 4,
does the predictive peak go up or down? Why?

lec02bi-u08-3-hint-text.name: lec02bi-u08-3-hint-text
lec02bi-u08-3-hint-text.text:
回看第 1 節加權和圖。
Revisit the weighted-sum figure of Section 1.
Discuss answers in class or on the discussion board.

lec02bi-u08-4-title.name: lec02bi-u08-4-title
lec02bi-u08-4-title.text: 後驗與限制讓估計更誠實

lec02bi-u08-4-summary-text.name: lec02bi-u08-4-summary-text
lec02bi-u08-4-summary-text.text:
貝氏：保留後驗，再積分預測。
最大熵：守住限制，不加假設。

lec02bi-u08-4-en.name: lec02bi-u08-4-en
lec02bi-u08-4-en.text:
Bayes retains the posterior and integrates to predict.
Maximum entropy respects known constraints without extra assumptions.
More data narrows the posterior; predictive variance includes σN².
